data.one_liner: Provides a widget to customize the iOS back swipe gesture width.
data.what_it_does: Adds a theme widget that lets you set a fixed or fractional width for the iOS back‑gesture area. It works with CupertinoPageTransitionsBuilderCustomBackGestureWidth to apply the setting app‑wide.
use_when: You need to increase or limit the swipe‑back zone on iOS devices
You want a consistent back‑gesture width across the whole app
avoid_when: The app runs only on Android or other platforms
You are fine with Flutter's default back‑gesture behavior
strengths: Simple API with fixed or fractional options
Null‑safe and works with existing MaterialApp
weaknesses: Only affects iOS back‑gesture, no effect on other platforms
Limited to width customization, no other gesture tweaks
